entries.title: Matthew 22:1
segments: Once more Jesus answered them in parables.

entries.title: Matthew 22:2
segments: "The kingdom of heaven," he said, "may be compared to a king who made a wedding-feast for his son.

entries.title: Matthew 22:3
segments: "He sent out his slaves to summon the invited guests to the feast, but they did not want to come.

entries.title: Matthew 22:4
segments: "Again he sent out other slaves. 'Tell the invited guests,' he said, 'that my luncheon is now ready; my oxen and fat cattle are killed; everything is ready; come to the wedding-feast.'

entries.title: Matthew 22:5
segments: "They, however, paid no attention, but went off, one to his own farm, another to his business;

entries.title: Matthew 22:6
segments: "while the rest seized his slaves and maltreated and murdered them.

entries.title: Matthew 22:7
segments: "Then the king's wrath was roused, and he sent his troops and destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

entries.title: Matthew 22:8
segments: "Then he said to his slaves, "'The wedding-feast indeed is ready, but the invited guests were not worthy.

entries.title: Matthew 22:9
segments: "'So go out into the partings of the highways, and summon everybody you find there to the wedding-feast.'

entries.title: Matthew 22:10
segments: "So those slaves went out into the roads, and gathered together all whom they found, good or bad, and the banquet-hall was filled with the guests.

entries.title: Matthew 22:11
segments: "Then the king came in to inspect his guests, and he discovered there a man who had not put on a wedding-garment. He said to him,

entries.title: Matthew 22:12
segments: "'Friend, how did you come in here without a wedding-garment?' "The man was speechless.

entries.title: Matthew 22:13
segments: "'Bind him hand and foot, 'said the king to his officers, 'and cast him into the outer darkness; there will be the wailing and the gnashing of teeth.'

entries.title: Matthew 22:14
segments: "For there are many called, but few are chosen."

entries.title: Matthew 22:15
segments: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might ensnare him during conversation.

entries.title: Matthew 22:16
segments: So they sent their disciples to him, with the Herodians. "Teacher," they said, "we know that you are honest, and that you are teaching the way of God in sincerity; and are not afraid of any one, for you do not court men's favor.

entries.title: Matthew 22:17
segments: "Give us your advice, then: Is it allowable to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?"

entries.title: Matthew 22:18
segments: And Jesus, because he knew their malice, said:

entries.title: Matthew 22:19
segments: "Hypocrites! Why are you tempting me? Show me the tribute money." So they brought him a shilling.

entries.title: Matthew 22:20
segments: "Whose likeness and inscription is this?" he asked.

entries.title: Matthew 22:21
segments: "Caesar's," they answered. Then he said to them, "Render unto Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and unto God the things that are God's."

entries.title: Matthew 22:22
segments: When they heard this they were astonished, and left him and went away.

entries.title: Matthew 22:23
segments: That very day there came to him some Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection: and they questioned him.

entries.title: Matthew 22:24
segments: "Master," they said, "Moses taught that if a man dies without issue, his brother is to marry the widow, and raise up a family for his brother.

entries.title: Matthew 22:25
segments: "Now there were of our number seven brothers; and the first married and died. As he had no children, he left his wife to his brother;

entries.title: Matthew 22:26
segments: "In the same way the second also died, and the third, unto the seventh.

entries.title: Matthew 22:27
segments: "Last of all the woman died.

entries.title: Matthew 22:28
segments: "In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? They all had her."

entries.title: Matthew 22:29
segments: In answer Jesus said: "You err because you do not know the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

entries.title: Matthew 22:30
segments: "For in the resurrection men do not marry, nor are women given in marriage, but they are like angels in heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 22:31
segments: "But concerning the resurrection of the dead, did you never read what was spoken to you by God,

entries.title: Matthew 22:32
segments: "I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living."

entries.title: Matthew 22:33
segments: And when the crowds heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

entries.title: Matthew 22:34
segments: As soon as the Pharisees heard that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they gathered themselves together,

entries.title: Matthew 22:35
segments: and one of them, a lawyer, tested him by asking a question:

entries.title: Matthew 22:36
segments: "Master, which is the great commandment in the law?"

entries.title: Matthew 22:37
segments: Jesus answered, "You shalt love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind.

entries.title: Matthew 22:38
segments: "This is the great and first commandment.

entries.title: Matthew 22:39
segments: "The second, which is like it, is this, "You shalt love your neighbor as thyself.

entries.title: Matthew 22:40
segments: "On these two commandments hang the whole law and the prophets."

entries.title: Matthew 22:41
segments: Now while the Pharisees were together, Jesus put this question to them:

entries.title: Matthew 22:42
segments: "What is your opinion concerning the Christ? Whose Son is he?" "David's," they answered.

entries.title: Matthew 22:43
segments: "How then, " he said, "does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

entries.title: Matthew 22:44
segments: "The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit You on my right hand Until I put thine enemies beneath your feet?

entries.title: Matthew 22:45
segments: "If David calls him Lord, how can he be his Son?"

entries.title: Matthew 22:46
segments: No one could answer him a word, nor did any one dare from that day to ask him another question.
